RECLASSIFIED during Stage 12 feasibility check: originally logged as a bare 'swing' at ~181, but frame review (2fps, t=175-190) shows contact ~183-184 followed by the batter dropping the bat and running to first while fielders converge through ~186-188 -- this is a fair ball, not a miss. Window end capped at 185 (not the visually-observed ~187) because clip_540.mkv only reliably decodes to ~185.4s via OpenCV (see pipeline/motion.py's container-vs-decodable-duration note) -- ffmpeg CLI frame extraction can read a few seconds further than the pipeline's own cv2.VideoCapture ever will, so a window past that point could never be satisfied and would be a false regression failure, not a real one.
